name: Songyi-Power
summary: Songyi-Power is SIASUN's wheeled humanoid robot for industrial material handling, factory logistics, flexible production lines and warehouse automation. Its column lift supports handling work across different heights. The manufacturer exhibited this strength-oriented model at the 2026 World Robot Conference.
